theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_elp_integer_order
theorems.statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (x : F), Transcendental K x → (∀ f : F, ∃ a b : Polynomial K, b ≠ 0 ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b) → ∀ q : Polynomial K, q.Monic → Irreducible q → ∃ ν : F → ℤ, ν 0 = 0 ∧ ν (Polynomial.aeval x q) = 1 ∧ (∀ f g : F, f ≠ 0 → g ≠ 0 → ν (f / g) = ν f - ν g) ∧ (∀ f : F, f ≠ 0 → (0 ≤ ν f ↔ ∃ a b : Polynomial K, ¬ q ∣ b ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b))
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the accepted polynomial-exponent and fraction-extension dependencies; cancellation of common powers gives the nonnegative-order characterization.
